name: Music Assistant
description: Browse Music Assistant, control players and groups, and play music on this kiosk with an encrypted Sendspin receiver.
author: Mark Andrew

settings.title: Music Assistant server
settings.description: Choose an accessible Music Assistant Home Assistant app. Leave blank to use the only available server.

settings.title: Default player
settings.description: The player selected when the plugin opens. Temporary player choices do not change this setting.

settings.title: Auto-revert after idle (seconds) · 0 = disabled
settings.description: Return to the default player after the selected player is idle. Default: 60 seconds. Enter 0 to disable.

settings.title: Ducking · % of current local music volume
settings.description: Local music level during voice interactions, as a percentage of its current volume. Range: 1–10%; default: 10%.

settings.title: Prevent screensaver while playing
settings.description: Keep the screensaver from starting while the selected Music Assistant player is playing. Does not change Kiosk preferences.

settings.title: Hardware buttons control group volume
settings.description: While this kiosk's local receiver is playing in a group, use its hardware volume buttons to adjust the group. Off by default.

settings.title: Enable this kiosk's receiver
settings.description: Allow encrypted Sendspin playback on this kiosk. Playback control of other players does not require a local receiver.

settings.title: Receiver name · blank follows Kiosk
settings.description: Optional name shown in Music Assistant. Leave blank to follow this kiosk's name.

settings.title: Server override · blank discovers automatically
settings.description: Advanced: override the discovered Sendspin endpoint. Leave blank for normal setup; encrypted transport and server trust checks still apply.

settings.title: Remembered discovery server
settings.description: Saved server identity used by receiver discovery. Normally managed by the plugin.

settings.title: Previous default format
settings.description: Compatibility setting for older installations. Use Default player for current setup.

settings.title: Previous local player
settings.description: Legacy player ID retained for upgrades. Use Default player for current setup.

buttons.title: Check Music Assistant connection
buttons.label: Check
buttons.description: Read-only check of the saved server, sign-in and player access. Does not pair, save settings or start playback.
